= camel get genai

Display the model calls, agent runs and tool calls of the Camel AI components


== Usage

[source,bash]
----
camel get genai [options]
----



== Options

[cols="2,5,1,2",options="header"]
|===
| Option | Description | Default | Type
| `--content` | Show the question of each agent run (recorded at camel.aiObservability.level=full) |  | boolean
| `--duration` | How long to keep watching or following, in millis or as a duration such as 30s (default: until Enter is pressed) |  | long
| `--id` | Show one call (an agent run, a model call or a tool call) with its messages |  | String
| `--json` | Output the answer of the genai dev console as JSON |  | boolean
| `--limit` | The number of the newest agent runs and model calls to show | 20 | int
| `--timeout` | How long to wait for the integration to answer, in millis or as a duration such as 30s | 10000 | long
| `--watch` | Execute periodically and showing output fullscreen |  | boolean
| `-h,--help` | Display this help and exit |  | boolean
|===
